privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Pakhlai collects, uses, and protects information when you discover restaurants, place orders, or use a customer account.

information.title: Information we collect
information.body: We may collect account details, contact information, delivery locations you choose to save, order details, support messages, and basic device or usage information needed to operate and secure the service.

use.title: How we use information
use.body: We use information to show relevant restaurants, process and track orders, support customers, remember preferences, prevent abuse, and improve Pakhlai's ordering experience.

sharing.title: When information is shared
sharing.body: We share only the information needed to fulfill an order with the selected restaurant and relevant service providers. We do not sell personal information.

retention.title: Storage and retention
retention.body: We retain information only for as long as it is needed for the service, legal obligations, dispute handling, and security. Appropriate technical and organizational safeguards are used.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You control when location access is requested and can use a manually entered area instead. You may contact us to ask about, correct, or request deletion of your account information.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Pakhlai's restaurant discovery and online ordering services. By using the platform, you agree to use it lawfully and provide accurate order information.

accounts.title: Accounts and information
accounts.body: You are responsible for accurate account and delivery details and for protecting your login information. Tell us promptly if you believe your account has been used without permission.

orders.title: Restaurants, menus, and orders
orders.body: Restaurants are responsible for their menus, availability, preparation, delivery settings, and fulfillment. Review the restaurant, items, quantities, prices, and delivery details before confirming an order.

cancellations.title: Changes, cancellations, and refunds
cancellations.body: Availability and cancellation options can depend on the restaurant and the order's preparation status. Contact the restaurant or Pakhlai support promptly when an order needs attention.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Do not misuse the platform, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, submit fraudulent orders, or use content in a way that violates applicable law or another person's rights.

service.title: Service availability
service.body: We work to keep Pakhlai accurate and available, but restaurant availability, network access, and third-party services can change. We may update the platform and these terms as the service evolves.

faq.title: Questions Restaurant Teams Ask First.
faq.description: Clear answers based on the current Pakhlai RMS functionality.

what.question: What is Pakhlai RMS?
what.answer: Pakhlai RMS is a restaurant management system for managing orders, kitchen operations, menus, inventory, staff, procurement, finances, QR menus, and branches from one connected platform.

who.question: Who is Pakhlai designed for?
who.answer: Pakhlai is designed for restaurants, cafes, fast food businesses, multi-branch restaurants, restaurant groups, and growing food businesses.

branches.question: Can I manage multiple branches?
branches.answer: Yes. Pakhlai includes branch management, branch-specific operations, and branch-level permissions.

kitchen.question: Does Pakhlai support kitchen stations?
kitchen.answer: Yes. Pakhlai includes kitchen management, kitchen stations, order routing, order tracking, and production workflows.

inventory.question: Can I manage inventory and procurement?
inventory.answer: Yes. Pakhlai supports inventory, ingredients, recipes, stock operations, procurement, purchase invoices, suppliers, and stock transfers.

staff.question: Can I manage staff and permissions?
staff.answer: Yes. Pakhlai supports staff management, roles and permissions, attendance, station assignment, payroll, and related staff workflows.

qr.question: Does Pakhlai support QR menus?
qr.answer: Yes. Pakhlai supports restaurant-specific menu access and QR menu experiences.

demo.question: Can I book a demo?
demo.answer: Yes. Use the demo call-to-action on this page to start the conversation.

started.question: How do I get started?
started.answer: Start by configuring your restaurant, branches, menu, staff, and operating modules, then connect daily workflows inside Pakhlai.

custom.question: Can Pakhlai be customized for my restaurant?
custom.answer: Pakhlai is built around configurable restaurant workflows such as branches, roles, menus, kitchen stations, and operational modules.
